programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Maybe Its Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchants mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its Cop Shop Babes as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Sorcerer The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snakes true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob bosss collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the citys patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk an

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: Its an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wifes rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. Its one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Chengs friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Nezha

programme.title: 金钱帝国 I Corrupt All Cops

programme.title: 我要做特务 Call Me Agent

programme.title: 锁战 The Locksmith
programme.desc: 锁匠山叔在意外罹患失智症后，收了爱徒程浩仁浩仁继承了山叔的精湛技艺，精通开锁，甚至青出于蓝警探刘业信经常请浩仁协助开锁，二人因此成为好友某天，浩仁偶遇多年未见的旧友，意外揭开了山叔妻子离奇失踪的真相，连串怪事亦随之而来.

programme.title: 出租家人 We are Family
programme.desc: 沉迷于演戏的临时演员志光，加入由家聪与立志成为女演员的佩怡一起成立的出租家人公司，变成出租临时家人当他们出演临时家人服务时，发现家庭成员间的复杂关系，并建立更深入的联系.

programme.title: 第二十条 Article 20
programme.desc: 检察官韩明在工作和家庭中面临重重挑战：他的儿子与同学发生冲突，妻子随之介入，而他在工作上又要处理与合作伙伴的紧张关系除此以外，一宗重要的案件正考验着他对正义的坚持为了追求公平与正义，韩明决定孤注一掷，冒险一切.

programme.title: 爆裂点 Bursting Point
programme.desc: 毒品调查科总督察李振邦派出警方卧底江铭渗入贩毒集团希望能捣破首脑韩洋一次警方突袭失败后，激起韩洋复仇怒火而在金三角供应毒品原料的膺秀亦被迫要与警方合作，捣破毒犯巢穴一场警匪大战旋即展开！.

programme.title: 兰心大剧院 Saturday Fiction
programme.desc: 1941年，著名演员于堇返回上海排演旧情人执导的话剧她的出现却使各方纷纷设局，刺探她回归的真正目的当于堇执行其间谍任务的时候，她开始怀疑自己应否揭发有关偷袭珍珠港的紧急情报.

programme.title: 七月返归 Back Home
programme.desc: 自幼有阴阳眼的向荣，某日收到母亲自杀不遂的消息已移居外地的他返回香港旧居，却又看到比从前更恐怖的怪事徘徊在人鬼当中，向荣决意要看清真相，走出恐惧的阴霾.

programme.title: 冲天火 Sky on Fire
programme.desc: 任职于顶尖秘密医疗设施的保安主任宗天保，在一名年轻窃贼盗取一种突破性新药后，卷入了一场激烈的争斗然而，当他揭开该药物的真正起源后，宗天保必须寻找可靠的盟友来保护这药物，确保它不落入歹徒之手，并阻止一场残酷的争夺战爆发.

programme.title: 我们的十八岁 Lonely Eighteen
programme.desc: 香港八十年代，Elaine与好友李羡英为脱贫而踏入娱乐圈，李羡英成为当年红极一时的艳星，Elaine则在演员与自我身份上迷失十年后，娱乐事业的风光渐退，两人也因彼此的选择而走上了两条截然不同的人生路.

programme.title: 焚城 Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？.

programme.title: 瞒天过海 The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: 年轻貌美的企业家乔文娜被控为一宗密室杀人案的疑凶，而死者正是她的情夫乔文娜找来一名警察协助她洗脱罪名，调查期间他们揭发另一牵涉乔文娜和她情夫的凶杀案，真相逐渐浮出水面.

programme.title: 阴目侦信 YUM Investigation
programme.desc: 阴目侦信是专门助人解决灵异问题的侦探社当阴目侦信调查恶鬼在一栋旧楼出现的案件时，发现所谓的恶鬼都是由炼鬼师亲自炼成，目的是要恐吓居民以清空楼宇作重建之用阴目侦信的侦探们最后能否找到打败炼鬼师的方法？.

programme.title: 风林火山 Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: 故事发生在被白雪覆盖弥漫超现实氛围的香港，一场爆炸夺去了暗中操控贩毒集团的药业大亨的性命，令整座城市陷入混乱警方束手无策，家族企业濒临崩溃富商的小儿子誓言摧毁这个建立在罪恶之上的商业王国，却同时要面对在逃兄长的阻挠，以及父亲旧部为争夺势力版图而展开的激烈角逐.

programme.title: 不说话的爱 MuMu
programme.desc: 木木是一名开朗的七岁女孩，与失聪的父亲小马一同生活在聋人小区中她是父亲与外界沟通的唯一桥梁然而，当失散多年的母亲突然出现时，他们平静的生活被打扰，木木也被迫进入听人的世界与此同时，小马却遭到犯罪集团的诱骗，意外卷入一个专门利用聋人从事犯罪的陷阱中.

programme.title: 镖人: 风起大漠 Blades of the Guardians
programme.desc: 隋乱将至，逃犯镖客刀马受命护送神秘人，自西域大漠远赴长安不料护送对象竟是天字第一号逃犯，引发各方势力围追堵截，荒漠沙海间厮杀不断随着阴谋逐渐浮出水面，刀马被卷入一场牵动天下的朝廷与江湖博弈，在危机四伏的长安路上，展开一场生死难测的血战.

programme.title: 热搜 Trending Topic
programme.desc: 网络媒体主编陈妙发布一篇热爆文章成为热搜后，间接导致一名女孩自杀随后陈妙收到一个求助讯息，并发现事件的真相远非表面所见随着事件的公众舆论迅速改变风向，一场为弱者发声之战正式展开！.

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进.

She dreams of becoming a designer and slowly works her way to achieve her dream.

programme.title: 自然系女子旅行 The Joy Of Nature

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always And Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 不懂撒娇的女人 My Unfair Lady
programme.desc: 点石成金的商场管理界女强人凌敏宣萱旗下商场获奖无数，更是个超级控制狂，堂妹凌禹勤唐诗咏作为她的头号助手，唯命是从任劳任怨，更练出伪撒娇本领，为凌敏摆平不少麻烦正当凌敏事业得意，有望晋身董事局时，公司竟请来商场推广界鬼才文念深林文龙与她平起平坐！这对爱恨交缠的前度情人在职场大斗法，凌敏不惜起用绰号上海撒破郎的美女实习生田蜜高海宁接近念深以套取情报，岂料田蜜不但觊觎凌敏的事业，更看上她的男人，两女展开激烈斗争！另一边，禹勤揭发花心男友何志超黎诺懿北上出轨，在灰心之时遇上最情深的暖男程日晖王浩信，以为能与他修成正果，却杀出个甜美温柔的台湾表妹向他表白，禹勤马上相形见拙！更糟糕的是，日晖似乎对婚姻异常恐惧，以结婚为志愿的禹勤，是否嫁杏无期？这对不懂撒娇能干强悍的堂姊妹，最终是否能扭转厄运，获得幸福？.

programme.title: 金宵大厦 Barrack OKarma
programme.desc: 萧伟明陈山聪饰来到残旧且品流复杂的金宵大厦当看更，遇上这里的空姐住客Alex 李施嬅饰容貌竟与梦中一直缠绕自己的旗袍女子相同！阿萧接近Alex，了解更多彼此的关联其间金宵大厦怪事不断，不停上演着其他住客的人生及奇幻故事；阿萧更发现Alex竟是一个残影！六十年代金宵舞厅的舞女COCO李施嬅分饰，梦见自己未来当了空姐，恋上与梦中男子外貌相同的警察刘旭辉陈山聪分饰，奇梦还被书店主人林若思张彦博饰写成小说阿萧一路追查，意外发现这本旧小说，惊悉自己与Alex有一段扑朔迷离的宿世情缘.

programme.title: 洪武三十二 Relic Of An Emissary
programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.desc: 明太祖朱元璋驾崩，传位长子之子朱允炆陈山聪，但遗诏不知所踪，其近身侍卫敖笑风谢天华奉命追查，在查探过程中认识了燕王朱棣马德钟的得力谋臣马三保陈键锋，二人斗智斗力，惺惺相惜，但笑风得知朱棣正密谋夺位，唯对三保保持戒心笑风一次执行任务受伤失忆，由心狠手辣的作风变回有恻隐之心，一向痛恨锦衣卫的永晹公主朱樱江若琳却怀疑性情变好的笑风另有图谋，着好友三保小心防备失掉记忆后的笑风虽续受允炆重用，却对身边人心存疑虑，像神秘女子沈千三徐子珊和为人深藏不露的朱棣，每次碰面总让他内心泛起一种难以形容但熟稔的感觉；在一次奉命歼灭朱棣的行动中笑风得知了一个秘密，令他身陷义愤与自责的交战中.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Lisa dari sebuah NGO masuk ke kampung untuk membantu Bayu yang menjadi mangsa rogol. Insiden tersebut mengingatkan Lisa kejadian yang sama pernah berlaku kepadanya 7 tahun lalu di rogol oleh sekumpulan lelaki bertopeng. Bayu kemudiannya meninggal dunia. Mbah Ngai dibantu oleh Afifa membantu Siti anak Pak Samad yang sedang kemurungan. Afifa mengambil kesempatan, kononnya Siti terkena ilmu hitam. Pak Samad membayar sejumlah wang upahan kepada Afifa bagi membalas dendam perbuatan bomoh tersebut. Mbah Ngai menjaga Sarah anak kepada Afifa yang mengalami tekanan. Manakala Afifa menggunakan ilmu hitam ke atas Mak Leha, emak kepada Bayu. Manakala Lisa bersama Syamil seorang bekas Inspektor meneruskan siasatan mereka bagi menangkap perogol Bayu.

programme.desc: Tiga Pengacara, Chef Adu Amran, Fiza Frizzy dan Kelvin Yap akan menyelami dan merasai pengalaman kehidupan masyarakat lokal dari pelbagai etnik.

programme.title: Seribu Nina
programme.desc: Straight-laced Amar is having second thoughts about marrying his free-spirited girlfriend, Nina. But when Nina is kidnapped, he must embark on an interdimensional journey to find his love.

programme.title: L TVS Pagi
programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Duyung
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jimmy, seorang pemuda kampung yang mencintai alam sekitar dan hidup sederhana di tepi laut. Suatu hari, dia menyelamatkan seekor ikan duyung yang bertukar menjadi gadis jelita bernama Puteri. Pertemuan itu mengubah hidup Jimmy dan mencetuskan pelbagai kejadian lucu serta romantik antara manusia dan duyung.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Surga Di Telapak Kaki Ibu
programme.desc: Kisah Bayu, remaja yang hidup bersama ibunya setelah ayahnya meninggal. Bayu merasa tertekan kerana kemiskinan dan sering menyalahkan ibunya atas nasib mereka. programme.title: 29 Februari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Budi, seorang lelaki yang dilahirkan pada 29 Februari 1896 dan hanya meningkat usia setiap empat tahun sekali. Sepanjang hayatnya, Budi menyaksikan pelbagai perubahan zaman dan kehilangan insan tersayang, sehinggalah dia bertemu cinta sejatinya, Lily, yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya.

programme.title: Kembalinya Nenek Gayung
programme.desc: Kembalinya Nenek Gayung tells the story of the return of Nenek Gayung, a mysterious old woman associated with supernatural events and a series of terrifying incidents. A group of young people become involved in strange and frightening encounters while uncovering the mystery behind her reappearance, mixed with comedic moments.

programme.title: Surat Kecil Untuk Tuhan
programme.desc: Kisah dua beradik yatim piatu, Anton dan Angel, yang terpisah selepas kemalangan ketika hidup dalam sindiket pengemis jalanan. Bertahun kemudian, Angel yang telah berjaya sebagai peguam kembali ke Jakarta untuk mencari semula abangnya yang hilang.

programme.title: Dilan 1990
programme.desc: Cerita cinta remaja antara Dilan, seorang pelajar yang unik dan romantik, dengan Milea, pelajar baru yang berpindah ke Bandung pada tahun 1990. Cara Dilan yang berbeza dalam mendekati Milea membuatkan hubungan mereka berkembang, tetapi mereka juga perlu menghadapi cabaran persahabatan, sekolah dan kehidupan remaja.

programme.title: Reaksiar
programme.desc: Program yang memaparkan perkongsian pengalaman dan reaksi artis-artis jemputan setelah melihat kembali klip-klip lakonan mereka.

programme.title: Dilan 1991
programme.desc: Sambungan kisah cinta Dilan dan Milea selepas mereka menjadi pasangan. Hubungan mereka mula diuji apabila Dilan semakin terlibat dengan geng motor dan pergaduhan di sekolah, menyebabkan Milea risau dan hubungan mereka menjadi tegang. Milea terpaksa membuat keputusan yang sukar demi masa depan mereka.

programme.title: Kasih Seorang Ayah
programme.desc: Husin yang baru memulakan pekerjaan baharu dikejutkan oleh panggilan isterinya, Aminahayahnya, Pak Yusof, tidak pulang sejak keluar pagi tadi. Setelah mencari ke merata tempat, Husin akhirnya menemui Pak Yusof di sebuah perhentian bas dalam keadaan keliru dan ketakutan. Pak Yusof tidak ingat jalan pulang, malah tidak tahu di mana dia berada. Hairan dengan perubahan sikap ayahnya, Husin membawa beliau ke klinik. Di situlah mereka menerima berita yang mengejutkan: Pak Yusof menghidap Alzheimer. Dari saat itu, bermulalah perjalanan penuh cabaran buat Husin dan keluarganya dalam menjaga insan yang mereka sayangi.

programme.title: Jika Fattah
programme.desc: Kehadiran Fattah yang merupakan seorang anak yatim di dalam keluarga Zaidi telah mengubah kehidupan mereka sekeluarga melalui sikap terpuji yang ada di dalam diri Fattah yang menyedarkan Zaidi dan isterinya Intan.

programme.title: Salina
programme.desc: Salina tinggal di sebuah banglo cantik yang mempunyai sejarah misteri. Apabila kejadian aneh dan menakutkan mula berlaku, terutamanya terhadap anak-anaknya, Salina mula menyiasat sejarah banglo itu untuk melindungi mereka. Namun, keadaan menjadi semakin teruk sehingga membawa kepada kematian yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: Taikun
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua lelaki bernama Tai dan Kun, sahabat baik yang hanya meminati pergaduhan dan mencuri. Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Olimpias Way
programme.desc: Seorang penyanyi pop berusia 70 tahun yang pernah menjadi legenda muzik memulakan satu perjalanan merentasi tempat-tempat yang pernah menaikkan namanya. Dia menyewa seorang gadis muda yang pemalu sebagai pemandu, dan bersama-sama mereka melalui perjalanan emosi yang penuh kenangan, perubahan diri, dan hubungan antara dua generasi. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka mula memahami erti kehidupan, kehilangan, dan kebebasan untuk memilih jalan sendiri.

programme.desc: Hancur hati Dita Kenya Nindia apabila mengetahui suaminya, Joni Rizal Akbar berselingkuh dengan Re Larasati Kusnandar, yang merupakan teman sekolahnya dahulu. Dita semakin terluka apabila Joni lebih memilih Re dan meninggalkannya. Setelah tiga tahun menjanda, akhirnya Dita berkahwin semula dengan Dio Zidni Hakim. Namun keadaan semakin rumit apabila Joni dan Re tidak dapat menerima Dita yang hidup bahagia dan berniat untuk menghancurkan rumah tangga Dita dan Dio.

programme.title: Konser Luar Biasa Sayang Via Vallen
programme.desc: Konser Luar Biasa: Sayang Via Vellen merupakan acara musik istimewa meraikan perjalan kerjaya penyanyi dangdut Indonesia, Via Vallen. Konsert ini menyiarkan persembahan lagu-lagu hit Via Vallen antaranya yang paling popular, Sayang. Selain dari persembahan solo beliau, Via berkolaborasi dengan pelbagai artis, seperti Candil, Didi Kempoit dan adiknya, Merfinda dan Mela, mempamerkan nyanyian duet yang hebat.

programme.title: Cinta Sedalam Rindu
programme.desc: Aluna menyangka takdirnya hanyalah sebagai anak kepada seorang pembantu rumah yang terpaksa mengorbankan cintanya demi Felicia, anak majikannya. Namun, apabila rahsia dari masa lalunya terbongkar, seluruh hidup mereka berubah sama sekali.

programme.title: Salingka Bumi Minang
programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: The Joy Of Nature
programme.desc: Taiwans camping destinations are breathtaking! Hong Kong host Lin Yinghui, along with three of Taiwans goddesses Lin Xiang, Zhang Yahan, and Huang Shangyan, embarked on a nature-themed healing trip. They traversed Nantou, Kaohsiung, Taoyuan, and other locations, delving into the Miaoli mountains, trying out forest cabins, luxury campervans, deluxe tents, and even camping at a baseball stadium Surrounded by mountains, they enjoyed open-air hot springs, watched the sunset at the beach, explored historical sites near the campsites, and immersed themselves in nature. Finally, they returned to Yangmingshan in Taipei for camping, soaking in hot springs, and overlooking the unparalleled night view of Taipei! Besides experiencing the unique atmosphere of camping, what sparks will fly between the Taiwanese and Hong Kong women as they interact and bond?

programme.title: Winter Night
programme.desc: Zheng Daqian Qiao Xin, a struggling office worker suffering setbacks in both love and career due to urban lifes hardships, receives compensation for the demolition of her hometown in Northeast China and embarks on a journey back. A geomagnetic storm caused by a fireball leaves her train stranded in the wilderness. Witnessing the fireball, Zheng Daqian is shocked to find herself transported to a parallel universe! There, she encounters her deceased father, her mother who left despite never divorcing her, and her childhood friend and lost first love, Mu Zili Ma Sichao! Unable to return to her original world, Zheng Daqian seizes this opportunity to make amends for her past regrets, and the seeds of a budding romance with Mu Zili begin to sprout with the arrival of spring. Unfortunately, the fireball reappears, and Zheng Daqian and Mu Zili are destined to become lovers separated by two worlds, unable to touch each other!

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness!

programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry

programme.title: Winter Night

programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages. In this charming drama, Wu his wife become their daughters greatest haven, through the ups and downs they face as married women.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan presents a series of tales and folktales in Taiwan that have been pass down from one generation to another generation.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the Heartbroken Sword style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the others parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: Fox Hunt
programme.desc: Adapted from true events, Fraudster Dai swindled countless victims across China before vanishing without a trace. Seven years later, he resurfaces in Paris. Led by Detective Ye Jun, the Chinese Fox Hunt Team launches a high-stakes cross-border mission to recover the stolen assets and uncovers shocking secrets during the pursuit.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over the death of her young son by becoming a foster parent. For 13 years, Meis dedication to the foster child leads her to neglect her husband and the true needs of the child. It is only through the childs unintentional help that the couple finally manages to salvage their relationship.

programme.title: Hell Hole
programme.desc: The movie features three horror stories in different era: a pregnant woman haunted by a ghost sacrifices her life to save her baby a boy commits suicide after being bullied by four medical students and his spirit returns for revenge some company staff are haunted after they open a box of used clothes, releasing a more than 20-year resentment.

programme.title: WE12
programme.desc: An underground organization, The League of Kaito has been maintaining international order. While 12 elite members possess extraordinary skills and have worked independently for a period of time, they must rekindle their long-lost team spirit to accomplish a mission together to save the world from disaster.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: Good Game
programme.desc: Facing skyrocketing rent and dwindling customers, a middle-aged internet caf owner assembles a ragtag team for a HK500,000 eSports tournament. He recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a dismissed pro gamer. What follows is an impossible battleone that finally lets these dreamers fight with no regrets.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee sparks a Tang Dynasty Mission Impossible! Low-ranking official Li Shan De must deliver it a thousand miles in three days to satisfy a consorts craving. Racing against time, he encounters obstacles and absurd demands, turning the journey into a satirical adventure filled with tension and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Red Line
programme.desc: A former professional car racer, Le falls into despair after causing his brothers death in a car race, until he meets female doctor Hui and becomes an ambulance driver who vows to save lives with speed. Meanwhile, the truth about his brothers accident emerges with the investigation of Les three good friends...

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Xiao Fei is a cheerful girl who has been abandoned by her mother. One day, she encounters a gifted young man named Zi Wai, who is battling a rare disease. Determined to help him, she embarks on a journey to find his lost love. Even when they discover that the drug treating Wai is ineffective, they choose to embrace hope and love together.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Caught In Time
programme.desc: Based on true events, Detective Zhong Cheng leads a task force in pursuit of Eagle, a criminal gang led by Zhang Sun. Highly methodical and disciplined, the gang manages to avoid capture after each heist. A decade later, the need to stop Eagle is more urgent than ever when Zhong Cheng realizes that his time is almost up to solve the case.

programme.title: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: This dark comedy begins with an unidentified corpse appearing at the doorstep of a residential flat. Fearing that the corpse will turn their flats into haunted flats, which will cause a drastic drop in the property value, the four families living on the same floor attempt to move the corpse away, embroiling themselves in chaos.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world where humans have ceased to dream, a monster drifts through the fading illusions of the dreamworld. Clinging to visions no one else can see, its solitude is interrupted by a woman uniquely gifted to perceive these hidden dreams. Choosing to step into the monsters dreams, she seeks the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: The Brotherhood Of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a polices son, blames his father for his mothers death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Full Moon Scimitar
programme.desc: Swordsman Ding fought against many swordsmen and won, so he took his first defeat badly and wanted to commit suicide. It is then that he meets the granddaughter of a mystic Sect leader and falls in love. When they want to get married, the Sect leader presents Ding with the Full Moon Scimitar, on the condition that he will never leave the sect.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love rectangle, Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the speed gang, led by Johnny, and Kuos sister Carrie is molested by Johnnys brother Michael. Kuos family continues to be harassed by the speed gang while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The films action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Cat vs Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of Money, Sex And Love, this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: Heaven Sword And Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from Nine Yang Scriptures by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy familys daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his familys background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiance, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Heaven and Hell
programme.desc: When an angel, Ling, decides to help his two friends who have fallen in love to escape from Heaven, he is sent to live as a human on earth as his punishment. Reincarnated as a cab driver, he sacrifices his own life to save another ill-fated couple and lands in hell, where he has to face off against the ghosts and demons to fight his way out!

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the Tsai Li Fu style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Taos real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: Thangaraja
programme.desc: Engal Thanga Raja is about a brother who seeks revenge for the murder of his brother by pretending to be an escaped convict.

programme.title: Burma Nagar Das
programme.desc: Follows a close circle of friends in a tiny village school. It seamlessly flashes between their past and present, highlighting the camaraderie and enthusiasm of their adolescence.

programme.title: Mark Antony
programme.desc: Mark, the son of a former gangster, comes across a mobile phone that can time-travel. Using the phone, Mark acquires the ability to save his estranged mother from a grim fate.

programme.title: Dikkiloona
programme.desc: Mani, a lineman for the electricity board, comes across a time machine. He uses the device to travel back to the past and change his life.

programme.title: Kamali From Nadukaveri
programme.desc: Kamali, a young woman, strives hard to land a seat in a prestigious educational institute. Her journey soon inspires others from her small village to follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: 日落下的彩虹
programme.desc: 斌嫂自從離家後，重新學習一個人生活；斌哥則留守華麗理髮廳，思念斌嫂而不敢行動但這時，卻突發出現一個震撼彈：原來Windy懷孕兼被渣男分手，傷心得醉倒街頭斌哥斌嫂大為緊張，Windy卻死撐堅稱不需爸媽理會，反正二人離婚也同樣一意孤行，令一家人陷入僵局！另一邊廂，Sunnie 和 Moon得知消息後，毅然放下本身恩怨，去找Eddie晦氣，為姊妹出一口氣！Windy一直搖擺在生與不生之間，得到弟弟晨仔開解，才剛想嘗試做個好媽媽，卻在此時突然下體流血，痛得快要昏倒，她本能地按出了一個電話號碼求救

programme.title: 跳祭少女放飛假期
programme.desc: 兩位少女要親眼見證上天賜予的天然禮物，如何透過一雙神之手化為傳奇她們深入直擊石川傳統漆器的誕生過程一塊平凡的木頭從樹木被砍伐開始，經歷無數道繁複而細緻的工序，最終才能演變成驚艷世人的精美漆器，徹底顛覆了她們對手工藝的想像！除了感官震撼，考驗隨即延伸至當地的日常生活兩位少女要親自上陣，走入熱鬧的魚市場挑戰劏魚絕技，隨後更要落手落腳學習掘番薯在這些看似平凡卻極講求手感的庶民日常中，她們能否極速開竅，領悟將自然食材與原料昇華的匠人靈魂？

programme.title: 듀얼
programme.desc: quot살인마 VS 추격자, 똑같이 생긴 두 놈을 쫓아라!quot 나와 모든 것이 똑같은 복제인간이 이 세상에 존재한다면? 그리고 그가행하는 연쇄살인의 범인으로 내가 지목된다면? 모든 기억을 잃고 납치와 살인의 누명을 쓴 복제인간 성준 누명을 벗기 위한 유일한 방법은 이 모든 사건의 진범인 또 다른 복제인간 성훈을 잡는 것. 기억을 잃은 복제인간 VS 절대악 연쇄살인마의 숨 막히는 추격전! 하나뿐인 딸 수연을 납치 당한 강력팀 형사 득천은 기억 속 납치범과 똑같이 생긴 성준을 검거하려는 순간 성준과 똑같이 생긴 남자성훈을 보게 되고, 딸의 치료비 제공을 조건으로 득천에 사건 조작을 제안한 욕망에 찬 검사 조혜는 모든 것을 버리고 딸을 찾아 나선 득천을 추격하기 시작하는데... 인간 복제라는 거대한 비밀에 휘말린 득천과 성준, 그리고 이들이 펼치는 절대악 연쇄살인마와의 목숨을 담보로 한 대결은 박진감 넘치는 추격 스릴러 로서, 빠져들 수 밖에 없는 재미를 선사할 것이다.

programme.title: 광복80주년 특집기획 다시보는 속기록 대한민국 정치사
programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.
